title: Chinese governance in practice: six source families
scope: Six bounded collections: five new source families and one CN023 enrichment. Documentary evidence of implementation is source-attributed, with enforcement, testing, procurement, fiscal self-reporting, institutional outcomes and administrative filings kept distinct. Historical legal evidence is not legal advice.
source_snapshot_limit: Reviewed metadata preserves source URLs and locators. No exact upstream HTML/PDF byte identity is claimed; captured source text, original intake and result photograph are not published.
third_party_rights: Original research metadata does not extend source grants. Public access does not clear source prose, standards, photographs, submissions, underlying workpapers or bulk acquisition.
verdict: Retain six research collections: five new families plus CN023 provincial enrichment. Prioritize enforcement/reinspection, CNCERT organized testing and procurement corrections/awards. Institutional reports do not establish completed compliance, independent audit or model safety. One CNCERT specification remains deferred; no operational admission.

priority_ranking.basis: Reinspection directly reports response to prior instructions; selective and incomplete outcomes.
Two bounded executed-testing aggregates; strongest initial adapter readiness.
Amended purchasing conditions and commissioned oversight resources with explicit stage distinctions.

baseline_inventory.scope: Frozen 64-family inventory plus five relevant accepted research catalogs at current main; targeted reuse, not full re-audit.

novelty_summary.scope: No exact target artifact/family duplicate found in the five inspected accepted catalogs; no claim of global event uniqueness.

overlap_review.result: CGP006 is provincial row-level enrichment, not a seventh/new filing family. National/provincial representations need record-type/identifier deduplication.
Normative policy, ethical norms and Shanghai AI Lab SafeWork framework remain distinct from enforcement, procurement, fiscal self-reports and the separate Shanghai software centre.

overlap_review.target: Chinese safety catalog ZHS001–ZHS008 and CN019/CN020
overlap_review.result: Benchmark collections and capability inputs do not duplicate the CNCERT executed-testing rounds or CAICT institutional-result presentation. No shared exact target artifact found.
Self-disclosure/implementation distinction transfers, but these five source families have no Chinese-governance target artifact match. Same evidence type does not establish duplication.

No exact target artifact found in accepted catalogs. A regulator bulletin can later link to an incident representation; an authorized test vulnerability is not automatically a realized incident. External incident index event matches were not exhaustively searched.

Procurement/deployment relationship concepts are related, but no exact source-family/artifact match. Filing list inclusion, award and acceptance remain distinct entities; no concentration or exposure denominator follows.

interpretation_guards: Historical documentary evidence, not legal advice.
Jurisdiction describes authority/procedure; no nationality-based risk, intent or compliance inference.
Keep regulator findings, orders, executed tests, certificate presentations, procurement clauses, awards, fiscal self-reports and filings separate.
Do not translate 安全 into a single universal safety construct; retain original context and English gloss.
Preserve source publication, event, effective, fiscal and retrieval dates; null is not zero.
Preserve original units and document revisions; do not aggregate overlapping reports or changing populations.
No p(doom), AGI-date, capability or national compliance/safety score may be derived.
No blanket open licence established; factual metadata/links is proposed scope, not a legal clearance conclusion.
Source prose, photos, workpapers, standards texts and private submissions have separate rights.
Unnecessary personal names and contact details are excluded from public metadata.
